name: Beijing Zhong Ke San Huan High-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Zhong Ke San Huan High-Tech Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and markets magnets and magnetic devices in China and internationally. The company offers sintered Nd-Fe-B magnets for transportation, energy, communications, home appliances, machinery, and medical equipment applications; bonded Nd-Fe-B magnets for information technology, energy saving home appliances, consumer electronics, and control components applications; and soft ferrites for mobile communication equipment, internet system, SPC digital switch, switching mode power supply, CRT monitor, LCD, PDP, OA, automatic control, green illumination, instruments, industrial and medical…
